jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
Als HR Business Partner bij HCI Paramedie ben jij de HR-expert waar de directeur van de business unit en de leidinggevenden mee sparren. Je zit dicht op de praktijk: bij het gesprek dat een manager liever uitstelt, en bij de verandering die eraan komt. Er verandert het nodige bij Paramedie, en jij staat middenin die beweging. Jij zorgt dat mensen snappen waarom, en dat het netjes gaat.

Wat ga je doen?

HCI Paramedie maakt software voor fysiotherapeuten en andere paramedici. Hoe soepeler het hier loopt, hoe beter die software wordt en hoe minder administratie een behandelaar overhoudt. Jouw doel is een gezonde business unit: de juiste mensen op de juiste plek en leidinggevenden die hun werk aankunnen.

Jouw taken:
Je adviseert de directeur van de business unit en de leidinggevenden over alles wat met mensen en organisatie te maken heeft.
Veranderingen begeleid je van plan tot uitvoering, inclusief de communicatie eromheen.
De jaarlijkse performancecyclus draai jij voor de business unit en je bewaakt de kwaliteit ervan.
Bij lastige zaken rond functioneren, inzetbaarheid en verzuim voer jij de regie.
Je coacht leidinggevenden, ook op de gesprekken die ze liever niet voeren.
Komt er een kantoor bij, dan help je dat op HR-gebied aansluiten op de rest van HCI.
Eén keer per jaar trek je een project dat over heel HCI gaat, bijvoorbeeld op beloning of op leren en ontwikkelen.

Over ons

Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 230 collega's aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. Bij HCI Paramedie kom je in een pragmatisch team dat hard werkt en zichzelf niet te serieus neemt. Duidelijke afspraken, goed werk en af en toe een goede grap horen er allemaal bij. Jij zorgt dat het HR-deel daarvan net zo goed geregeld is.
Je werkt voor de business unit Paramedie en hoort tegelijk bij het HR-team van HCI, met twee andere business partners, HR-administratie en recruitment. Je brengt stevige HR-ervaring mee, dus collega's zullen je regelmatig even bellen om mee te denken. Je rapporteert aan de HR Director. Het HR-team is volop in ontwikkeling, dus je komt binnen op een moment dat er nog veel te vormen valt. Dat is eerlijk gezegd het lastigste en het leukste aan deze baan tegelijk

Wat bieden we jou?

Salaris: € 3.911,- tot € 5.588,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.
8% vakantiegeld en goede pensioenregeling.
Hybride werken: op ons fijne kantoor in Hoofddorp en 2 dagen vanuit huis.
25 vakantiedagen, de mogelijkheid om 10 dagen bij te kopen.
Reiskostenvergoeding, thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 per dag en thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 500,- per twee jaar.
Leren & ontwikkelen: volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, met aandacht voor jouw professionele én persoonlijke groei.
Werkplezier: collegiaal team met hart voor zorg & technologie.
Gezonde gezelligheid: elke maandag samen lunchen en leuke team-uitjes.
Werken bij de marktleider in zorg-IT: 5.000+ zorgpraktijken, 4+ miljoen eindgebruikers, impact op schaal.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent stevig genoeg om een manager tegen te spreken en aardig genoeg dat hij je daarna weer belt. Je werkt zelfstandig, denkt praktisch en voelt goed aan wat er in een organisatie speelt. Werkt iets niet, dan zeg je dat gewoon.
Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau, richting HRM, bedrijfskunde of iets vergelijkbaars.
Ongeveer vijf jaar ervaring binnen HR, waarvan minimaal twee jaar als HR-adviseur of business partner.
Je hebt zelf een performancecyclus gedraaid, inclusief kalibratie en de gesprekken die daarbij horen.
Ervaring met organisatieverandering, het liefst in een bedrijf dat snel groeit.
Goede kennis van de Nederlandse arbeidswetgeving.

Interesse?

Wil jij jouw HR-skills inzetten voor een betere zorg? Dan leren we je graag kennen!
Stuur je cv naar vacatures@hci-software.com en we nemen snel contact met je op.

Het sollicitatieproces

We bekijken je sollicitatie zorgvuldig. Sluit je ervaring aan, dan ga je kennismaken met onze recruiter.
Bij een match volgt een eerste gesprek met de HR-director a.i. en een van onze teamleden.
Je maakt een business case en deze bespreek je met Maarten (Managing Director Paramedie) en Patricia (HR Business Partner). Aansluitend heb je een korte kennismaking met onze CFO Mark.
Klikt het van beide kanten? Dan doen we je een aanbod!
VOG aanvraag, op onze kosten natuurlijk.

We verwelkomen sollicitaties van iedereen. Voel je vrij te reageren, óók als je niet ieder vinkje zet. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – Information Technology (IT)
jobs.description:
About Resillion

Resillion is a global provider of digital assurance, cybersecurity, and testing services. We help organisations strengthen their security posture, protect critical assets, and deliver high-quality digital solutions. Our teams operate across multiple specialist disciplines, including Digital Forensics, Incident Response, SOC Operations, Quality & Compliance, and Technical Consultancy. We are committed to excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering trusted, customer-focused services that meet the highest professional and accreditation standards.

Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – Information Technology (IT)

Location:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Salary:
Dependant on level of experience
Job Type:
Full-time, Permanent (Hybrid) – 3 days a week in the Amsterdam Office with occasional travel to the Hasselt Office in Belgium

This role would be suitable for an established IT Agency Recruiter looking to move to an In-House role/

** PLEASE NOTE – WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT APPLICANTS WHO ARE HIGHTLY FLUENT IN BOTH DUTCH AND ENGLISH AND HAVE PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE RECRUITING INTO BELGIUM, THE NETHERLANDS AND GERMANY **

Help Shape the Future of Technology Talent

We're looking for a passionate Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – IT
to join our collaborative Global People team.
This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in attracting and hiring the talented professionals across Belgium, The Netherlands and Germany
who help deliver innovative software testing, quality assurance, and cyber security solutions to clients across the BeNeDE region and beyond.
This role will be the sole Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – IT
for the region but working closely with other Talent Acquisition professionals in both the UK and India, you'll partner with hiring managers across the business, influence recruitment strategy, and create outstanding candidate experiences while helping us scale our growing organisation.

What You'll Be Doing

As a trusted Talent Acquisition / Recruitment Partner – IT
, you'll own the full recruitment lifecycle for a wide range of technical positions, including permanent and contractor hires with a strong focus on Direct Sourcing.

Build strong partnerships with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs and workforce plans.
Manage end-to-end recruitment from vacancy briefing through to offer and onboarding.
Direct Source high-quality IT professionals using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, talent mapping, and proactive direct sourcing search techniques.
Develop and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements.
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout every stage of the recruitment process.
Advise stakeholders on recruitment best practice, market trends, salary benchmarking, and hiring strategies.
Support contractor recruitment while ensuring compliance with IR35 and relevant UK employment legislation.
Champion diversity, equity and inclusion by embedding inclusive recruitment practices into every campaign.
Create engaging recruitment marketing content for LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
Use recruitment data and metrics to continuously improve hiring outcomes.

What We're Looking For

You'll be an experienced recruiter who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and takes pride in finding exceptional technology talent.

You will bring:

Proven experience recruiting within the IT or Technology sector.
Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle across permanent and contractor hiring.
Strong direct sourcing skills with confidence using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools to avoid any agency reliance
Experience recruiting IT Software Testing, QA, Cyber Security or Digital professionals would be highly desirable
Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
Knowledge of right-to-work legislation, and current recruitment best practice.
Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
A proactive approach to talent pipelining and workforce planning.
Experience creating engaging recruitment campaigns across social media.
A genuine passion for delivering an outstanding candidate experience.
Previous experience within an in-house Talent Acquisition or RPO environment would be advantageous.
Experience recruiting Software Testing, QA, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, or Digital professionals would be highly desirable.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you'll be recognised for:

Building trusted relationships with hiring managers.
Delivering high-quality hires through direct sourcing.
Developing strong talent pipelines for future growth.
Improving time-to-hire and quality-of-hire metrics.
Driving diversity and inclusion across recruitment activities.
Providing an exceptional recruitment experience for candidates and stakeholders alike.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a recruitment role—it's an opportunity to influence how we attract, engage, and hire the talented people who will shape our future.
You'll join a supportive, collaborative team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is trusted, and you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact while developing your career in Talent Acquisition.

jobs.title: Director, HR Business Partner, International
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together.

Opportunity Overview

Rhythm Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced and collaborative Director, Human Resources Business Partner to support employees and leaders across our Italian, Spanish, International Marketing, International Market Access and International Medical teams. As the primary HR partner for these teams, this role will provide both tactical guidance and hands-on support across the employee lifecycle.

As a key member of the International HR team, the successful candidate will work closely with the Executive Director, International HR Business Partner to develop and execute people strategies that support business growth while aligning with global priorities and local market needs.

This role is ideal for an HR leader with experience in small to mid-sized pharmaceutical or biotechnology organizations who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building solutions, and is equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up their sleeves to support managers and employees directly.

Responsibilities & Duties

Serve as the primary HR partner for employees and leaders across our Italian, Spanish, International Marketing, International Market Access and International Medical teams, providing guidance and hands-on support across the employee lifecycle.
Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, talent management, employee engagement, change management, and leadership development, helping to build high-performing and inclusive teams.
Provide guidance on employee relations, performance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and other workplace matters, while supporting the administration of talent processes including objective setting, employee development, and succession planning.
Partner with hiring managers to identify talent needs, support recruitment for key commercial and medical roles, and ensure a positive candidate and onboarding experience.
Support the execution of regional HR programs and initiatives, including learning and development, talent reviews, organizational development, and employee engagement activities.
Ensure compliance with employment laws and labor practices across their client groups, partnering with internal stakeholders and external counsel on employment law, policy, compliance, and risk management matters.
Provide operational support for international benefit programs, including plan administration, employee guidance and communications, vendor interactions, and renewal and implementation activities across multiple countries.
Support the development and implementation of HR policies, processes, and best practices that balance business and compliance needs.
Collaborate closely with payroll, the broader HR team, and the Executive Director, International HR Business Partner to deliver a consistent employee experience and execute regional people strategies that support continued business growth.
Ensure all activities are conducted in strict accordance with applicable laws, regulations, industry standards, internal compliance requirements, and Rhythm policies, while upholding the highest standards of ethics, integrity and business conduct.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree and/or HR certification preferred.
10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant HR Business Partner experience supporting leaders and employees across multiple countries and/or functions.
Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or healthcare industry, preferably within a small to mid-sized, growing organization.
Strong knowledge of employment law, labor practices, benefits, and HR compliance requirements within one or more of the countries supported.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex employee relations matters and provide practical, business-focused guidance to leaders.
Experience supporting commercial, medical affairs, and/or corporate functions.
Strong business acumen, communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business strategy into effective people solutions.
Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Collaborative, pragmatic, and solution-oriented approach, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and support the business directly.
Ability to identify opportunities, manage complexity and priorities and liaise, influence internally to ‘make it happen’ whilst being comfortable working with uncertainty
Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results
Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Italian language skills are highly desirable

More about Rhythm

At Rhythm our core values are:

We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives
We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions
We are eager to learn and adapt
We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success
We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission

Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do.
